answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and solves a chain of 10 fresh challenges hung on the trellis board; each link is signed with its willow key and stamped by the quartz clock. Auditors replay every link; a copied link breaks the chain and burns the bond. First pays 105, the k-th 105+4(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,103,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 35 once, bond reclaimed. Rented-link rings fail: one willow key signs one chain.
